fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I’ve let all of the critters know you’re awake.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Well, almost all of them, but word travels fast here…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]So tell me. What is it you’re here for?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]… Mmmm. I think I know what you’re gettin’ at.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Haha, you’re not the first fella comin’ ‘round here to sleep around!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]I can imagine what you may have heard about our little town…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]But unfortunately, it doesn’t quite live up to the rumors.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Y’see, we’ve all got things to do and lives to lead.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Can’t possibly expect us to be bangin’ about all day!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]Who’ll put dinner on the table? Who’ll fetch supplies for the town? Who’ll fix the broken bridge?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]See, we’re just a town like anywhere else.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]THOUGH that’s not to say we don’t have our fun!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]In fact! Now that I know that’s what you’re after, I can fill everyone else in…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Oh, let me fill ya in on how things work around here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]If you see this above a critter’s head, it means they have something important to tell ya!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]If you see this, it means they’re waiting on you for something.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]If you see this, it means you’ve got something for them!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Lastly, when you see this, it means a critter has more to say on the topic.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Sometimes this is where the juicy stuff is!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]While you’re out and about, pick me up some sugar from Maverick!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Straight to the point! You’re my kinda panda dear~

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]And by the looks of ya down below, you’re just my size too!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]He’s the otter by the river. You’ll know him when ya see em!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Good to see ya back on your paws!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: The beaver lets out a long yawn.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Sorry - ya caught me in the middle of my afternoon nap!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]But you can just call me Bucky!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]If there’s anything ya need during your stay, don’t hesitate to ask!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Until then… I kinda wanna get back to my nap…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]I’m sure I’ll be seeing ya again very soon!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: He… seems to be quitely snoring… Wake him up?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3](Wow… Look at this guy. He’s even cuter when he’s conscious!)

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]I’m Mabel! Your friendly little neighborhood mouse!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]It’s a bit in shambles at the moment, but it’s home!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]I think we’ll get along quite well…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]You look more like a Red to me, Mind if I call you Red?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Nope! Don’t answer that, it’s already stuck!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]I like you Red, I can tell we’re gonna be good buds!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]By the way, didja’ pick up those treats I left ya?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]The chocolates! Chocolate covered coffee beans to be precise!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]They keep me goin’ when I’m slowin’ down, y’know?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I left them on the table with all the other food!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Go back to Scarlett’s House! You won’t regret it.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Ay Red! How can I help ya?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Picking up some Sugar? Sure thing, bud!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]OH SCARLETT HUH? Haha! Sure, right. “Sugar.” Yeah I’ll get ya some “Sugar!”

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]She didn’t tell ya? Haha, that lady’s never been out of sugar her entire life.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]“Sugar” is code for lube! But it’s more of an inside joke than anything.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]But yeah. That’s what she wants! Trust me.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Hello dear~ Did you get that sugar?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]How could I forget about our secret code!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]That’s very good of him, but I actually did need sugar…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Oh well! Could always use more lube!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I’ll just talk to him myself once I’m done with the chores here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]That’s a funny story how that “code” ended up coming about.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]See, my husband is a bit shy, especially when it comes to anything regarding sex.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]He hates it when I ask him to gather supplies, or pick something up from the neighbors.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]So I decided to make the code!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]“Sugar” is lubricant, “Spices” are toys, “Something nice” is how we refer to certain gear!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]It’s a whole thing, I think I got most of the town acquainted, oh hohoho~!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Rascal! I wanted to give you something.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]This should help you settle in a bit better.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]I remember the first time I went to a new place, it was easy to get overwhelmed.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]It helped having a notebook to jot down important information!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]If ya ever feel lost, or curious about something, refer to the notebook!
